title: Choose the visual world for darentan.my
question: The roll assigned The Annual Report. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Annual Report
options.lineage: Bursa Malaysia listed-group annual reports: key figures, group structure, profile of directors
options.thesis: Daren's decade reported the way boardrooms already read proof: figures, structure, statement.
options.viewport: Cover spread: name and title set large on an ultramarine plate whose art is 72,000 points, one per Developer Kaki member, beside a full-bleed stage photo; a key-figures strip and the LinkedIn action sit on the cover.
options.risk: Reads stiff and corporate if the figures and type are set timidly; it needs real typographic courage.

raised.raise: Key figures hold fixed tabular digit positions and roll digit by digit, never a soft count-up.
Every figure carries a numbered note to its source, like notes to the accounts.
Group-structure lines carry meaning by stroke: solid for owned companies, dashed for communities and partners.
Ultramarine is reserved for section plates and the LinkedIn action; it is never decoration.
Stage photos bleed to their own stage black and are never boxed on white.
Each spread holds one dominant figure inside a charged field of white.

options.label: The Interchange
options.thesis: ALPHV's four arms drawn as transit lines that all interchange at Daren.
options.viewport: A network diagram fills the screen; Daren is the interchange station, and the lines for Technologies, Academy, Developer Kaki and Recruit radiate to their own terminus pages.
options.risk: Transit maps are a familiar 'ecosystem' trope and the direction many runs land on; it can read as a dev-portfolio gimmick.

options.label: Mezzotint Velvet Night
options.thesis: Daren's stage photos emerge from rocked velvet black by burnishing.
options.viewport: A black plate with Daren's figure surfacing as light, engraved caption below.
options.case: Fuses poorly: boardroom and developer visitors don't identify with printmaking, and the darkness hides the ecosystem.
options.kept: Photos sit on their own stage black and are never boxed on white.

options.label: Creator Hardware Bench
options.thesis: ALPHV's arms as keys on a gunmetal deck, with LinkedIn as the one orange key.
options.viewport: A keycap grid of the four arms, with one orange LinkedIn key.
options.case: Fuses as a gadget: a keyboard of companies reads playful, not polished professional.
options.kept: One accent reserved for the one action that matters.

options.label: Ikebana Ma
options.thesis: One line of a career set off-centre in charged emptiness.
options.viewport: An asymmetric triangle of three proof points in empty plaster.
options.case: Fuses thinly: quiet emptiness can't carry ten years of dense proof.
options.risk: Too sparse for a mixed audience.
options.kept: Charged emptiness around one dominant element.

options.label: Hand-processed 16mm
options.thesis: Talks and episodes as frames on a scratched film strip.
options.viewport: A strip of talk frames with stamped edge codes.
options.case: Fuses only for talks and loses the ecosystem story.
options.kept: Every frame carries a stamped index.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Arms as numbered lanes tied to Daren by amber link lines.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes on black glass, with link lines to each venture.
options.case: Fuses as engineering chrome: amber on black reads as an ops console, not a founder.
options.kept: State drawn by stroke pattern, not hue.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: 72,000 and every other figure glowing in tube banks.
options.viewport: Tube banks for members, users, years and talks.
options.case: Fuses as a gimmick: glowing tubes upstage the numbers they show.
options.kept: Quantities are the interface; digits hold fixed positions.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A founder and keynote-speaker site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A large portrait beside name and title, a stats row, an 'as featured in' logo bar, then case-study cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every speaker site, including the current darentan.my.
